crossRefs.note: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.
He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
“Why do we sit still? Assemble yourselves! Let’s enter into the fortified cities, and let’s be silent there; for Yahweh…
Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, “Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood and…
Therefore Yahweh of Armies says concerning the prophets: “Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink…

translations.web: He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
translations.bsb: He has besieged me and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
translations.kjv: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
translations.asv: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
